en: Therīgāthā 6.4 Chakkanipāta Sujātātherīgāthā The Verses of the Elder Nun Sujātā, from the Sixth Chapter (The Group of Six) I was born into a wealthy family, Possessing great wealth and abundant grain. My father, having seen me, Gave me the name "Sujātā" (Well-Born). I was beautiful, possessing lovely features, With a complexion like refined gold. Many young men, seeing me, Desired me as their wife. But I, being wise and discerning, Did not desire the life of a householder. Having heard the Dhamma taught by the Buddha, I went forth into homelessness. For twenty years I lived the holy life, Practicing the training under the Blessed One. Then, through the power of my own exertion, I attained the state of an arahant. Now I am free from all suffering, Cool and peaceful, with all taints destroyed. Having reached the goal of the holy life, I dwell in bliss, having done what was to be done. I pay homage to the Teacher, To the Buddha, the peerless person. Through his teaching, I have crossed over The flood of birth and death, so difficult to cross. I am now one who has reached the further shore, A sage, awakened, and free from defilements. I am a nun who has attained liberation; I have found the safety of the island. I am no longer subject to rebirth, The burden is laid down, the fetters are severed. I have realized the Deathless, And I dwell in the bliss of Nibbāna. Thus did the Elder Nun Sujātā, Having attained the fruit of arahantship, Speak these verses of exultation In the presence of the Sangha of nuns.
“Adorned, well-dressed,
garlanded, anointed with sandalwood,
and covered with all kinds of ornaments— ”
Surrounded by a host of female servants,
taking food and drink,
and no small amount of hard and soft foods.
Having departed from my home,
I proceeded to the pleasure grove.
Having enjoyed myself and played there, I—
Returning to my own home,
I entered the Añjana Grove at Sāketa to visit the monastery.
Having seen the Lamp of the World,
I paid homage and drew near;
he taught the Dhamma to me.
Out of compassion, the One with Vision,
having heard [the words] of the Great Seer,
penetrated the Truth.
Right there I touched the stainless Dhamma,
the deathless state. Then,
having understood the true Dhamma,
I went forth into the homeless life;
the three knowledges have been attained;
the teaching of the Buddha has borne fruit.
… the Elder Nun Sujātā …
